flows.execution.flow:
// Hand-migrated from evals/migrate/source/sample/execution.flow (v2) to v3.
//
// Every scenario name is the original's, verbatim, and there is exactly one step
// per original step, in the original order (REQ-LANG-11). The original drove a
// third-party booking site through inline XPaths; v3 forbids locators in flows,
// so each target is rewritten as the phrase the equivalent control carries on
// apps/sample-web, which is what makes the flow recordable and replayable at all
// (D7, and the step mapping in docs/spec/progress/phase-1.md).
//
// The compensation showcase that stood here in the first migration — a "cancel
// booking" scenario, onFailure=compensate metadata, and a compose/test block —
// was not in the original. It moved to booking-compensation.flow.

scenario: start zoomcar booking
  Click the Book a slot link

scenario: perform search
  Click the location field
  Clear the location field
  Type "indra" into the location field
  Click the Indiranagar suggestion
  Click the next button

scenario: select date and time
  Click the slot date field
  Click the 09:00 slot time
  Click the next button
  Click the slot date field
  Click the 18:00 slot time
  Click the next button
  Wait 8 seconds

scenario: select car and login
  Click the Book now button
  Click the username field
  Type {data.user.email} into the username field
  Click the login button
  Type {data.user.password} into the password field

scenario: checkout the selected car
  Click the booking result
  Click the Checkout link

scenario: initiate payment
  Click the card number field
  Click the expiry month select
  Select "08" in the expiry month select
  Click the expiry year select
  Select "2027" in the expiry year select
  Click the CVV field
  Type {data.card.cvv} into the CVV field
  Click the card number field
  Type {data.card.number} into the card number field

scenario: logout
  Click the sidebar toggle
  Click the logout link
